title: QueryIntent
description: Structured decomposition of a raw developer query. Output of Stage 1 (intent extraction) in the RightStack retrieval pipeline. The retrieval system operates on this object, not the raw query string.

build_goal.description: Canonical single-sentence description of what the builder wants to accomplish, normalized from raw_query. Used for workflow matching.

primary_ecosystem.description: The primary blockchain/social layer the builder is targeting. null means not specified — a clarifying question should be generated if confidence is also low.

secondary_ecosystems.description: Additional ecosystems in scope (cross-chain queries). Empty array if only one ecosystem in scope.

scale.description: Builder's scale target. null means not specified — default to mvp if not determinable.

user_type.description: Inferred user type based on query signals. Affects recommendation depth and tradeoff presentation.

intent_categories.description: V2 ontology categories relevant to this query. Ordered by relevance (most relevant first). Used for category-level retrieval filtering — only tools in these categories are candidates.

workflow_match.description: ID of the best-matching WorkflowRecord from the workflow corpus. null if no confident match — fall back to category-based retrieval.

workflow_match_confidence.description: Confidence that workflow_match is the correct workflow. Below 0.6: present multiple workflow candidates to the user.

constraints.description: Extracted constraint signals from the query. Each constraint narrows the tool candidate set or adjusts scoring.

gasless_required.description: Builder explicitly needs gasless UX for users. Routes to account-abstraction category.

no_existing_wallet.description: Target users have no existing wallet. Routes to wallet-infrastructure subcategory=embedded.

has_existing_wallet.description: Target users have existing wallets (MetaMask etc). Routes to wallet-infrastructure subcategory=external-connection.

autonomous_agent.description: Agent operates without user interaction. Routes to wallet-infrastructure subcategory=server-side + agent-framework.

python_only.description: Builder requires Python. Affects agent-framework recommendations (LangChain over Vercel AI SDK).

high_frequency_execution.description: High-frequency trade or action execution. Routes to execution category, boosts Jito on Solana.

mev_sensitive.description: Trade or action execution is sensitive to MEV. Hard requirement for execution category tool.

cross_chain.description: App needs to function on multiple chains. Affects ecosystem weighting — multi-chain tools score higher.

hackathon_timeline.description: Builder needs to ship within hours or days. Applies hackathon scale modifiers from WorkflowRecord.constraint_modifiers.

social_features_required.description: App needs Farcaster social data or social interactions. Routes to social-layer category.

ai_reasoning_required.description: App includes AI agent reasoning or LLM integration. Routes to agent-framework category.

hybrid_wallet.description: App must support BOTH users with existing wallets AND users without wallets in a single flow. Routes to wallet-infrastructure tools that span both embedded and external-connection subcategories (e.g., Dynamic). Prevents false constraint contradiction when has_existing_wallet and no_existing_wallet are both true.

ambiguity_flags.description: Identified ambiguities in the query that may require clarification before high-confidence retrieval. If any flag is present and confidence < 0.7, generate a clarifying question.

resolution_options.description: Possible interpretations to present to the builder.

confidence.description: Confidence in the intent extraction. Below 0.65: generate a clarifying question before retrieval. 0.65-0.80: proceed with retrieval, note assumption. Above 0.80: proceed with full confidence.

repo_context.description: If a repo was analyzed, detected context that supplements the query. null if no repo provided.

detected_ecosystem.description: Ecosystem detected from repo dependencies. Overrides primary_ecosystem if more specific.

detected_tools.description: Tool IDs already present in the repo. Excluded from recommendation (already in use).

detected_anti_patterns.description: Tool IDs detected in the repo that match anti-patterns for the workflow. Flagged for review.

detected_missing_categories.description: V2 category IDs that production workflows in this ecosystem typically include but are absent from the repo.
